- Verified end-to-end flow for `/api/v1/streams`.
- Concurrent requests handled correctly.

title: Contract: Implement Global 'Pause' Mechanism (Emergency Shutdown)
body:
## Description
Add ability for contract owner/DAO to pause state-changing operations in case of an exploit.

## Requirements
- Define `Admin` storage key.
- Add `pause` and `unpause` functions.
- Wrap `create`, `withdraw`, `cancel` with check for pause state.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Operations are blocked when paused.
- Only authorized address can toggle pause.

title: Contract: Support for Minimum and Maximum Stream Durations
body:
## Description
Enforce platform rules on stream lengths.

## Requirements
- Configurable range (e.g., 1 hour to 5 years).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Prevents weird edge cases or spam streams.

title: Backend: Comprehensive Unit Testing for Streaming Service
body:
## Description
Ensure the core streaming service logic is robust through extensive unit testing.

## Requirements
- Use Jest for testing.
- Mock Soroban RPC responses.
- Test edge cases: zero amounts, invalid IDs, network timeouts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Coverage for `streaming-service.js` > 90%.
- All tests pass in CI.

title: Contract: Dynamic Rate Adjustment via Governance
body:
## Description
Allow active streams to have their rates adjusted if both parties agree or via DAO rules.

## Requirements
- Logic to recalculate based on remaining balance and new end time.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Flexible streaming terms.

title: Contract: WASM Binary Size Optimization Sprint
body:
## Description
Optimize the streaming contract to minimize WASM size and reduce deployment/execution costs.

## Requirements
- Review dependencies and remove unused features.
- Use compact Soroban data types.
- Apply `wasm-opt` or similar tools in build process.

## Acceptance Criteria
- WASM size reduced by at least 15%.
- No loss in functionality.

title: Backend: Enhance JWT Security with Refresh Tokens
body:
## Description
Current JWT implementation only uses access tokens. Add refresh tokens for better security and UX.

## Requirements
- Implement short-lived access tokens and long-lived refresh tokens.
- Store refresh token hashes in MongoDB.
- Add endpoint to rotate refresh tokens.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Users stay logged in securely without re-entering credentials.
- Revoked tokens are properly handled.

title: Contract: Transferable Stream Ownership
body:
## Description
Allow a sender to transfer their role (and refund rights) to another address.

## Requirements
- `transfer_sender` function.
- Update storage keys.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Streams can be 'sold' or transferred between accounts.

title: Backend: Deep Benchmarking and Optimization Sprint
body:
## Description
A dedicated task for profiling the server and optimizing hot code paths.

## Requirements
- Use Node.js profiler or flame graphs.
- Optimize async operations.
- Reduce memory footprint.

## Acceptance Criteria
- 20% improvement in general request handling.

title: Backend: Multi-Network Support (Testnet vs Mainnet) Configuration
body:
## Description
Refactor the backend to easily switch between different Stellar/Soroban networks.

## Requirements
- Move network-specific constants to `.env`.
- Support multiple RPC URLs and Network Passphrases.
- Dynamic contract ID loading based on environment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Backend works seamlessly on Testnet and Mainnet with config changes.

title: Contract: Batch Withdrawal Logic and Efficiency
body:
## Description
Allow a recipient to withdraw from multiple streams in a single transaction.

## Requirements
- Optimized loop over stream IDs.
- Shared authorization check.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Lower gas fees for power users.

title: Backend: Referral and Rewards Tracking System Logic
body:
## Description
Track referrals when users invite others to the platform.

## Requirements
- Referral code generation.
- Tracking which stream was created via which referral.
- Reward calculation logic.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Operational basis for marketing campaigns.

title: Backend: Develop Admin Dashboard API for Platform Management
body:
## Description
Provide administrative endpoints to monitor platform health and manage global configurations.

## Requirements
- Endpoints for TVL (Total Value Locked) calculation.
- Endpoints to toggle maintenance mode.
- Endpoints for user management (ban/unban).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Admins can retrieve system-wide metrics.
- All admin routes are protected by high-privilege JWTs.

title: Contract: Reentrancy Guard Protection Strategy
body:
## Description
Add protection against reentrancy attacks, especially for cross-contract calls.

## Requirements
- Basic mutex implementation for state-changing functions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Secure against known smart contract attack vectors.

title: Backend: Scheduled Stream Execution Service
body:
## Description
Logic to handle streams that should start at a future date/ledger.

## Requirements
- Worker to monitor when scheduled streams should become active.
- Internal state transitions in DB.
- Notifications to users.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Users can plan future payments.

title: Backend: Implement Webhook System for Stream Life-cycle Events
body:
## Description
Allow external services to react to stream events (created, withdrawn, canceled) via webhooks.

## Requirements
- Create a webhook registration API.
- Implement a reliable delivery mechanism with retries.
- Sign webhook payloads for security.

## Acceptance Criteria
- External endpoints receive POST notifications on stream events.
- Retry logic handles temporary failures.

title: Contract: Metadata Specification Implementation
body:
## Description
Adhere to Soroban contract metadata standards for better ecosystem compatibility.

## Requirements
- Implement metadata traits.
- Include logo URL, description, and version.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Contract details show up correctly in explorers.

title: Backend: Soroban Gas Price Monitor and Alerting
body:
## Description
Monitor the Stellar network for sudden spikes in gas/fee requirements.

## Requirements
- Polling service for fee stats.
- Alert threshold configuration.
- Inform users via API if fees are too high.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Admins and users are aware of network congestion.

title: Backend: Automate MongoDB Backups to S3/Local Storage
body:
## Description
Ensure data durability by setting up automated daily backups for the MongoDB database.

## Requirements
- Create a cron job or worker service for backups.
- Upload backups to a secure location.
- Implement a retention policy (e.g., keep last 30 days).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Backups are generated daily without manual intervention.
- Restoration script verified.

title: Backend: Soft Delete Implementation for Data Archiving
body:
## Description
Instead of deleting records, mark them as hidden to preserve history.

## Requirements
- Add `isArchived` or `deletedAt` fields.
- Update all queries to filter out archived records.
- Provide admin tool to restore data.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Accidental deletions can be recovered.
- Data integrity maintained.

title: Contract: Mandatory Event Logging for Every State Change
body:
## Description
Ensure full transparency by emitting events for every storage write.

## Requirements
- Review `update`, `create`, `delete` operations.
- Ensure all relevant data is in the event.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Off-chain indexers can track 100% of state changes.
